_meta.description: Non-universe entities named in the research prose, classified so the UI can tell the reader what is investable and what is context. Drives the linking convention.
_meta.convention: Company Name (TICKER) — ticker clickable = has an investing angle. Company Name (private) = not listed. Context-only names render as plain text with no link.

types.candidate: Listed, on-thesis, genuinely investable — referenced but not yet assessed for the universe. Clickable; opens a short 'not yet assessed' note.
types.context: Named for context only — customer, downstream buyer, or macro reference with no direct hard-asset investing angle. NOT clickable by design.
types.private: Privately held, no listed equity. Rendered '(private)'. NOT clickable.
types.state: State-owned, a JV, or otherwise not investable as listed equity. NOT clickable.

_meta.note: Names in companies.json are the investable universe (full drawer). Names in excluded.json were assessed and rejected (why-not note). This file covers everything else that gets mentioned.
